lines.zh: 我的骨头外面包着一层干肉。
lines.en: A layer of dried flesh wraps my bones.

lines.zh: 我走起来，肩上的肌肉在动。
lines.en: My shoulder muscles move as I walk.
I am faster and lighter than my kin.
I step over a fence and it breaks.

lines.zh: 我一步一步逼近，脚步很快。
lines.en: I close in quickly, step by step.
I clench my fists hard.

lines.zh: 我身上的肉是干的，不会掉。
lines.en: The flesh is dry and does not slough.

lines.zh: 哪边有响动，我往哪边走。
lines.en: I head toward whatever makes noise.

lines.zh: 我喘气像拉风箱，走得也急。
lines.en: I breathe like a bellows and walk just as hard.
I round a corner without slowing.

lines.zh: 我的脚印比人的大两圈。
lines.en: My footprints are twice a man's.
I do not hide, and I do not go around.

lines.zh: 我站着，肋下的干肉绷着。
lines.en: I stand, the dried flesh taut over my ribs.

lines.zh: 这层干肉还贴在骨头上。
lines.en: This dried flesh still clings to the bone.
I am working my fists.

lines.zh: 我盯着地面，想砸点什么。
lines.en: I stare at the floor, wanting to break something.
The anger never left.

lines.zh: 我抬头，转头骨响了一声。
lines.en: I raise my head; the skull clicks.
I shake out my hands; the knuckles pop.
I listen for the living.

lines.zh: 我没有盔甲，只有这身肉。
lines.en: No armor. Only this hide.
I have stood in this doorway a long time.

lines.zh: 近得我能听见你的牙在响。
lines.en: Close enough that I hear your teeth chatter.

lines.zh: 我盯你的时候，手在攥紧。
lines.en: While I stare at you, my hands clench.
Look at this flesh on me.
I am no ordinary skeleton.

lines.zh: 我比穿甲的那些更灵活。
lines.en: I am quicker than the armored ones.
Do not think I am slow.

lines.zh: 你才退半步，我的脸就近了。
lines.en: Half a step back and my face is already closer.
My anger does not hide.
Your breathing has gone ragged.
I want to hit someone now.
That tore off a piece of flesh.
One foot slips, then I hold.
No pain. Only more fury.
A little bone shows through.
I roll my shoulder; the joints crack.

lines.zh: 肉被削掉一块，骨头还在。
lines.en: A slice of flesh is gone; the bone remains.
I tear off the loose flesh.
That was a solid hit.
I keep my fist up regardless.

lines.zh: 别以为打掉一块肉就赢。
lines.en: Do not think tearing off flesh wins.
This dried flesh does not live on meals.
This flesh dried long ago.

lines.zh: 这层干肉，早就不吃东西。
lines.en: This dried flesh stopped eating long ago.
Only gums left in my mouth.
Put that bowl down.
One bite and it is gone. Got more?
I am not hungry. I am just angry.
Take it away. Do not block me.
It is you I want to hit, not that.
You are feeding the wrong thing.

lines.zh: 你这一撞，撞疼的是自己。
lines.en: That collision hurt only you.
My feet did not shift at all.
Move. I am on my way.
That knocked you back.
This flesh is harder than bone.

lines.zh: 我一转肩，你顺着甲滑开。
lines.en: I turn my shoulder and you slide off it.
We left prints on the ground.
Out of my way — I am in a hurry to break things.
I move a shoulder and you yield.
Again, and I strike.
This flesh is dry.
I stopped being a living man long ago.
Such talk does not suit me.
My kind only know fighting.
Do not say it beside me.
I only remember being angry.

lines.zh: 我连自己叫什么都不知道。
lines.en: I do not even know my own name.
Get yourself to one side.
I only want to hit someone.
Stop asking.
I pick up a brick.
My hand closes and it crumbles.
Light as a strip of dried bark.

lines.zh: 我抬手一甩，东西飞出老远。
lines.en: One flick of my arm sends it flying.
I lift a corpse.
I swing it around by one end.
I fling it down.
This iron is useful.
I tuck it at my waist.
I clench my fist again.
You flinched. That is enough.
Your steps land too heavily to hide.
Within one step, my fist arrives first.

lines.zh: 干肉下面的骨节绷紧了。
lines.en: The joints under this dry flesh tighten.
You turn around and I am already here.
The wall is at your back.
I press forward step by step.
The anger is rising.
I have marked your chest.
Stand still; save me the chase.

lines.zh: 我前脚离地，准备压下去。
lines.en: My front foot is off the ground.

lines.zh: 我的骨拳早在你背后举好。
lines.en: My bone fist was raised behind you already.
Stairs behind you. Mind the drop.
I never go around.
I roar at you.
You came at the right time.
I am about to strike.
One stride of mine and the floor shudders.
You run; I am faster.
I need no pause to breathe.
I knock a table over.
Changing direction will not help.
My fist stays raised; I never lower it.
You stepped on broken brick.
The harder you breathe, the steadier I get.
You are backing into a corner.
I kick a chair aside.
I am angry enough that my fingers shake.

lines.zh: 你第三次回头，我就在那。
lines.en: On your third glance back, there I am.
The room is small; you cannot run far.
Only a few steps left.
My hand blocks the lamp.
Do not head for that wall.

lines.zh: 柱子挡不住你的喘气声。
lines.en: A pillar cannot hide the sound of your breathing.
You cannot retreat now.
I have the doorway blocked.
Three breaths from now, I strike.
My fist comes down and the boards splinter.

lines.zh: 我比那些穿甲的打得快。
lines.en: I strike faster than the armored ones.
This fist lands on your shoulder.
My finger bones are hard.
You blocked it and still fell back.

lines.zh: 我拎着你的领子，抬到眼前。
lines.en: I haul you up by the collar to my face.
I go for your ribs.
You fly out and hit the doorframe.
This dry flesh is hard as wood.
I am not tired at all.
Still standing. Good.
I raise my elbow.
This one is heavier than the last.
I have not even panted.
You retreat; I take a step after.
The next fist will land heavier.

lines.zh: 我从土里扒出来，还带着干肉。
lines.en: I claw out of the soil, dried flesh still on me.
My fists come out first.

lines.zh: 我撑起身体，肩上的肉绷紧。
lines.en: I push up and the flesh on my shoulders tightens.

lines.zh: 这层肉不知道什么时候干的。
lines.en: I do not know when this flesh dried.
I raise my head and see houses.
Lights over there, and the living.
I clench a fist to test it.
More strength than I expected.
I walk toward that door.

lines.zh: 我从土里挣出来，石头碎了。
lines.en: I tear free of the soil; the stone cracks.
I was angry the instant my eyes opened.
I do not want to wait.
I knock; the doorframe breaks.
Someone shouted inside that door.

lines.zh: 火一烧，我身上的干肉全着了。
lines.en: Fire and the dry flesh on me catches.
I fall and my bones land loudly.

lines.zh: 水灌进干肉里，我变重了。
lines.en: Water soaks the dry flesh and I grow heavy.
The blast strips half my flesh away.
An arrow is stuck in my dried flesh.
A curse seeps into the flesh, cold.
I am not hungry, but the flesh is dropping off.
Lightning passes through and I light up.
The ground gives; I keep falling.
